# Simple Relay Documentation

> One binary. No infrastructure. Reliable HTTP delivery.

Simple Relay is a lightweight, self-hosted reliability layer for HTTP traffic. It provides durable webhook ingestion (persist-before-ACK), smart outbound retries with full jitter, dead letter queue (DLQ) replay, and an embedded administrative UI. It ships as a single zero-dependency binary.

## Documentation Index

- [Overview & Philosophy](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/overview): Core principles, zero-infra self-contained binary, inbound persist-before-ACK, client-abort cancellation.
- [Quickstart](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/quickstart): Single Docker command, binary run, first curl test, embedded UI access.
- [Inbound Webhooks](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/inbound-webhooks): Durable persist-before-ACK pipeline, raw HMAC signature verification, zero byte mutation.
- [Outbound Proxy](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/outbound-proxy): Synchronous proxying with automatic 429/5xx retries, client-disconnect abort, asynchronous background execution.
- [Retries & Dead Letter Queue](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/retries-and-dlq): Exponential backoff with full uniform jitter, thundering herd prevention, DLQ inspection and replay.
- [Recipe: Stripe & GitHub Webhooks](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/stripe-github): HMAC-SHA256 signature verification recipes and route definitions.
- [Recipe: 429 & Rate Limits](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/rate-limits-429): Surviving API rate limits, parsing Retry-After header (seconds & HTTP dates).
- [Recipe: Production Deployment](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/production-deploy): Docker Compose, Systemd unit, Litestream S3 streaming replication.
- [Recipe: Cloudflare Tunnel & Local Webhook Inspection](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/local-webhook-inspection): Local webhook inspection, crash-resilient server restarts, and one-click request replay.
- [Configuration Reference](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/configuration): CLI flags, environment variables matrix, and route configuration specs.
- [REST API Reference](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/api-reference): Webhook ingest, proxy endpoints, DLQ inspection, replay API, health check.
- [Embedded Web UI](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/embedded-ui): Real-time delivery logs, payload inspection, attempt history, DLQ replay.
- [CLI Reference](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/cli-reference): Embedded CLI subcommands (relay health, queue, dlq), health probes, queue depth monitoring, and headless DLQ replay.
- [Benchmarks & Performance](https://simplerelay.dev/docs/benchmarks): Measured throughput (10,000 req/s), latency percentiles, and memory footprint (26 MB).
